summary: Jackson County, OR ground cabin built 1922 on Rogue River NF; staffed by emergency lookouts in the 1930s; use ended 1942; structure removed 1959; no remains described.

facts.status_note: Lookout structure removed in 1959; no source describes what remains at the site

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives 1942 for abandonment and the register gives 1959 for removal; the chronology gives 1942 for end of use and 1959 for structure removal, so the dates describe different events.

notes_for_editor: Dates for build (1922) and removal (1959) agree across register and chronology. Firelookout.com's 'abandoned 1942' matches the chronology's end of use in 1942. The chronology's staffing entries come from newspaper reports it quotes; the name is spelled Ali in 1938 and Al in 1939. The Oregon Lookouts page also lists 1908-1913 references to an 'Ashland Butte' lookout; that is a different summit and is left out. The page's 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description is for a station about a mile south of Ashland city centre, not the mountain, so it is left out. Access and current remains are unknown; the Wikipedia ski-area line is a lead only. Record's access 'unknown' stays until a Forest Service source is found.
